pages.main_text_excerpt:
Committed to Cleaner Oceans, Skies, and Supply Chains
At SIEM Shipping, sustainability is more than an ambition. It is a responsibility embedded in how we operate.
From vessel design and fleet performance to everyday operational decisions, we are committed to reducing emissions, improving efficiency and protecting the environments and communities connected to our activities.
Our Approach to Sustainability
Shipping plays a vital role in global trade, and we recognise our responsibility to operate as efficiently and responsibly as possible.
Our approach combines modern vessels, cleaner fuels, smarter operations and continuous investment in technology. By making sustainability part of our long term decision making, we aim to improve environmental performance while continuing to provide safe, reliable and efficient maritime transportation.
Cleaner Fuels and Efficient Vessels
We continue to explore and adopt solutions that can reduce the environmental impact of our fleet.
This includes the use of cleaner and alternative fuels, energy efficient vessel designs and technical improvements that help reduce fuel consumption and emissions. Each investment is considered with a long term perspective, supporting both operational efficiency and the transition towards more sustainable shipping.
Smarter Fleet Operations
Sustainability is shaped not only by how vessels are built, but also by how they are operated.
Through careful voyage planning, performance monitoring and collaboration between our teams on shore and at sea, we continually look for opportunities to improve efficiency, optimise fuel consumption and reduce unnecessary emissions.
Our objective is clear: to minimise harmful emissions into the sea and atmosphere through the use of cleaner fuels, smarter fleet operations, continuous investment in vessels and new technologies, responsible environmental management and collaboration across our business and industry.
Sustainability at SIEM Shipping is a long term commitment built on innovation, accountability and action. As technology advances and industry expectations evolve, we will continue working to improve our performance and contribute to a more sustainable future for maritime transport.
pages.title: Sustainability at SIEM - Siem Shipping

From car carriers to reefers and offshore vessels, we combine an expansive fleet with global reach and diverse operations. With owned vessels, leasing, ship management and logistics all in the same place, we become a source of holistic, connected expertise.
These insights enable us to deliver consistently, design highly tailored solutions, drive progress in niche markets, and shape the future of global shipping
 
  
  
	
Crucially, we put our customers first in everything we do. It’s there in the way we prioritise partnerships and open collaboration, taking the time to understand your ambitions on a deep level – then deliver with agility and precision. And it’s there in the way we strive for better, more efficient operations, leading our industry with the adoption of clean, responsible fuels that drive down emissions.
Working with SIEM Shipping is working with a team that’s leading the shipping sector by example – and can lead you to success through our innovation and operational excellence

pages.main_text_excerpt:
SIEM Shipping is pleased to announce the addition of Siem Darwin (ex MV Lake Geneva) to our growing Pure Car and Truck Carrier (PCTC) fleet.
Built by Imabari Shipbuilding in Japan and delivered in 2015, Siem Darwin is a modern vehicle carrier designed to support global automotive logistics. The vessel offers a carrying capacity of up to 6,179 vehicles across 11 car decks plus a dedicated garage deck, enabling the efficient transport of passenger cars, high-and-heavy units and other rolling cargo.
Measuring 199.9 metres in length and flagged in Singapore, the vessel combines flexible cargo intake with proven operational reliability, making it well suited to serve established and emerging automotive trade routes worldwide.
Built for Global Automotive Logistics
Purpose-built for the demands of vehicle transportation, Siem Darwin is equipped with extensive deck space and specialised loading systems that allow for the safe and efficient handling of a wide range of cargo types. The vessel’s design supports both standard passenger vehicles and larger high-and-heavy cargo, providing the flexibility required in today’s evolving automotive supply chains.
The vessel is currently on long-term charter through to the end of 2028, supporting continued deployment across key global automotive trades. Its addition strengthens SIEM’s ability to deliver dependable capacity and long-term support to customers across the international vehicle logistics market.
With the introduction of Siem Darwin, SIEM continues to expand its PCTC fleet while reinforcing its commitment to reliable operations, strong partnerships and efficient global vehicle transport.
pages.title: SIEM Darwin Joins the PCTC Fleet - Siem Shipping

pages.main_text_excerpt:
SIEM Car Carriers is pleased to announce the addition of SIEM Edison (ex MV Lake Wanaka) to its growing Pure Car and Truck Carrier (PCTC) fleet, further strengthening its global automotive logistics offering.
Built in China in 2008, SIEM Edison has a total capacity of 4,900 vehicles. The vessel is equipped with multiple fixed and liftable decks, enabling the efficient transport of a wide range of rolling cargo across global trade routes.
Combining proven design with operational reliability, SIEM Edison supports flexible deployment across key automotive trades and is well suited to long-term charter operations.
The vessel is fixed on a long-term charter, supporting continued deployment across key global routes and reinforcing SIEM Car Carriers’ commitment to delivering consistent, high-quality service to its partners.
Delivering Reliable, Specialised Shipping Solutions
The addition of SIEM Edison reflects SIEM Car Carriers’ ongoing investment in fleet capability and its focus on maintaining reliable, specialised shipping solutions across the automotive sector.
SIEM Car Carriers looks forward to seeing SIEM Edison support its partners worldwide and contribute to the continued delivery of dependable maritime logistics services.
pages.title: SIEM Edison Joins the PCTC Fleet - Siem Shipping

pages.main_text_excerpt:
SIEM Shipping is pleased to announce that we have joined two leading industry associations: the Automotive Industry Action Group (AIAG) and ECG, the Association of European Vehicle Logistics.
These memberships reinforce our commitment to collaboration, operational excellence and continuous improvement across the global automotive supply chain.
Joining AIAG as Siem Car Carriers
We have re-joined AIAG as a Siem Car Carriers member, strengthening our alignment with global automotive standards and best practice.
AIAG brings together OEMs, suppliers and service providers to develop industry standards, improve supply chain performance and drive quality and sustainability initiatives worldwide. Through international forums, shared resources and structured collaboration, AIAG plays a central role in shaping the future of automotive logistics.
By participating in this network, we gain access to industry insight, shared learning and forward-thinking initiatives that enable us to deliver more efficient and reliable vehicle shipping solutions to our customers.
Becoming a Member of ECG
We are also pleased to confirm our membership of ECG, the Association of European Vehicle Logistics.
Since 1997, ECG has represented the interests of the finished vehicle logistics sector across Europe. With more than 200 member companies spanning road, rail, maritime and inland waterways, ECG serves as the collective voice of the industry at EU level.
ECG members operate one of the most extensive finished vehicle logistics networks in the world, including hundreds of car-carrying vessels and tens of thousands of specialised transport assets. By joining this community, SIEM strengthens its position within the European automotive ecosystem and reinforces its long-term commitment to high standards, responsible operations and cross-sector collaboration.
Building Stronger Industry Partnerships
The automotive supply chain continues to evolve, shaped by sustainability targets, regulatory change and increasing complexity across global markets. Active participation in industry associations such as AIAG and ECG ensures that we remain closely connected to these developments.
Through collaboration, shared standards and open dialogue, we will continue to build stronger partnerships and deliver reliable, efficient and forward-thinking vehicle logistics solutions.
Together, we are contributing to a more connected and resilient automotive logistics sector.
pages.title: SIEM Joins AIAG and ECG to Strengthen Automotive Industry Collaboration - Siem Shipping

pages.main_text_excerpt:
SIEM Car Carriers is pleased to announce the addition of SIEM Newton (ex MV Lake Kivu) to its growing Pure Car and Truck Carrier (PCTC) fleet, further strengthening its global automotive logistics offering.
Built in Xiamen, China in 2006, SIEM Newton has a total capacity of 4,888 vehicles. The vessel is equipped with multiple fixed and liftable decks, enabling the efficient transport of a wide range of rolling cargo across diverse trade routes.
With a length overall of 182.8 metres and a proven operational track record, SIEM Newton enhances the company’s ability to deliver flexible and reliable shipping solutions in support of evolving customer requirements.
Strengthening Fleet Capability and Support
The addition of SIEM Newton reflects SIEM Car Carriers’ continued investment in fleet capability and its commitment to maintaining high standards of operational performance across global automotive trades.
SIEM Car Carriers looks forward to seeing SIEM Newton support its partners worldwide and contribute to the continued delivery of dependable, specialised shipping services.

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Siem Global Logistics (SGL), in collaboration with Navecopa, is pleased to announce the appointment of Valmex as sales agent in Mexico. This step further strengthens our commercial presence in the region and reinforces our long-term commitment to the Mexican logistics market.
We are also pleased to welcome Paolo Peraza, who joins in support of commercial activities as Sales Manager. His appointment adds valuable local expertise as we continue expanding our reach across the automotive and RoRo sectors.
Aligning for Growth
Recently, representatives from Siem, Navecopa and Valmex met in Mexico City to align on strategy, market priorities and future growth. The discussions focused on developing logistics solutions tailored to the evolving needs of the automotive and roll-on roll-off markets, with an emphasis on reliable execution and strong local market knowledge.
By combining SGL’s global logistics network with Navecopa’s established operational presence and Valmex’s commercial capabilities, we are building a more integrated and responsive service offering across Mexico.
Expanding Regional Capability
Mexico continues to play a pivotal role in global automotive and industrial supply chains. Strengthening our sales and agency representation ensures closer proximity to customers, improved coordination and a clearer commercial structure to support growth across the region. This development reflects a shared commitment to building a stronger, more connected logistics network across Mexico and beyond.
Enquiries
For enquiries in the region, please contact:
SGL: sales@siemlogistics.com
Valmex: sales@valmexshipping.com
pages.title: Strengthening Our Logistics Presence in Mexico - Siem Shipping

SIEM Car Carriers is pleased to announce the addition of SIEM Edison (ex MV Lake Wanaka) to its growing Pure Car and Truck Carrier (PCTC) fleet, further strengthening its global automotive logistics offering.
Built in China in 2008, SIEM Edison has a total capacity of 4,900 vehicles. The vessel is equipped with multiple fixed and liftable decks, enabling the efficient transport of a wide range of rolling cargo across global trade routes.
Combining proven design with operational reliability, SIEM Edison supports flexible deployment across key automotive trades and is well suited to long-term charter operations.
The vessel is fixed on a long-term charter, supporting continued deployment across key global routes and reinforcing SIEM Car Carriers’ commitment to delivering consistent, high-quality service to its partners.
Delivering Reliable, Specialised Shipping Solutions
The addition of SIEM Edison reflects SIEM Car Carriers’ ongoing investment in fleet capability and its focus on maintaining reliable, specialised shipping solutions across the automotive sector.
SIEM Car Carriers looks forward to seeing SIEM Edison support its partners worldwide and contribute to the continued delivery of dependable maritime logistics services.
pages.title: SIEM Edison Joins the PCTC Fleet - Siem Shipping

pages.main_text_excerpt:
SIEM Shipping is pleased to announce that we have joined two leading industry associations: the Automotive Industry Action Group (AIAG) and ECG, the Association of European Vehicle Logistics.
These memberships reinforce our commitment to collaboration, operational excellence and continuous improvement across the global automotive supply chain.
Joining AIAG as Siem Car Carriers
We have re-joined AIAG as a Siem Car Carriers member, strengthening our alignment with global automotive standards and best practice.
AIAG brings together OEMs, suppliers and service providers to develop industry standards, improve supply chain performance and drive quality and sustainability initiatives worldwide. Through international forums, shared resources and structured collaboration, AIAG plays a central role in shaping the future of automotive logistics.
By participating in this network, we gain access to industry insight, shared learning and forward-thinking initiatives that enable us to deliver more efficient and reliable vehicle shipping solutions to our customers.
Becoming a Member of ECG
We are also pleased to confirm our membership of ECG, the Association of European Vehicle Logistics.
Since 1997, ECG has represented the interests of the finished vehicle logistics sector across Europe. With more than 200 member companies spanning road, rail, maritime and inland waterways, ECG serves as the collective voice of the industry at EU level.
ECG members operate one of the most extensive finished vehicle logistics networks in the world, including hundreds of car-carrying vessels and tens of thousands of specialised transport assets. By joining this community, SIEM strengthens its position within the European automotive ecosystem and reinforces its long-term commitment to high standards, responsible operations and cross-sector collaboration.
Building Stronger Industry Partnerships
The automotive supply chain continues to evolve, shaped by sustainability targets, regulatory change and increasing complexity across global markets. Active participation in industry associations such as AIAG and ECG ensures that we remain closely connected to these developments.
Through collaboration, shared standards and open dialogue, we will continue to build stronger partnerships and deliver reliable, efficient and forward-thinking vehicle logistics solutions.
Together, we are contributing to a more connected and resilient automotive logistics sector.
pages.title: SIEM Joins AIAG and ECG to Strengthen Automotive Industry Collaboration - Siem Shipping

pages.main_text_excerpt:
SIEM Car Carriers is pleased to announce the addition of SIEM Newton (ex MV Lake Kivu) to its growing Pure Car and Truck Carrier (PCTC) fleet, further strengthening its global automotive logistics offering.
Built in Xiamen, China in 2006, SIEM Newton has a total capacity of 4,888 vehicles. The vessel is equipped with multiple fixed and liftable decks, enabling the efficient transport of a wide range of rolling cargo across diverse trade routes.
With a length overall of 182.8 metres and a proven operational track record, SIEM Newton enhances the company’s ability to deliver flexible and reliable shipping solutions in support of evolving customer requirements.
Strengthening Fleet Capability and Support
The addition of SIEM Newton reflects SIEM Car Carriers’ continued investment in fleet capability and its commitment to maintaining high standards of operational performance across global automotive trades.
SIEM Car Carriers looks forward to seeing SIEM Newton support its partners worldwide and contribute to the continued delivery of dependable, specialised shipping services.

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Siem Global Logistics (SGL), in collaboration with Navecopa, is pleased to announce the appointment of Valmex as sales agent in Mexico. This step further strengthens our commercial presence in the region and reinforces our long-term commitment to the Mexican logistics market.
We are also pleased to welcome Paolo Peraza, who joins in support of commercial activities as Sales Manager. His appointment adds valuable local expertise as we continue expanding our reach across the automotive and RoRo sectors.
Aligning for Growth
Recently, representatives from Siem, Navecopa and Valmex met in Mexico City to align on strategy, market priorities and future growth. The discussions focused on developing logistics solutions tailored to the evolving needs of the automotive and roll-on roll-off markets, with an emphasis on reliable execution and strong local market knowledge.
By combining SGL’s global logistics network with Navecopa’s established operational presence and Valmex’s commercial capabilities, we are building a more integrated and responsive service offering across Mexico.
Expanding Regional Capability
Mexico continues to play a pivotal role in global automotive and industrial supply chains. Strengthening our sales and agency representation ensures closer proximity to customers, improved coordination and a clearer commercial structure to support growth across the region. This development reflects a shared commitment to building a stronger, more connected logistics network across Mexico and beyond.
Enquiries
For enquiries in the region, please contact:
SGL: sales@siemlogistics.com
Valmex: sales@valmexshipping.com
